name: megascenes-animate-drawing
description: Bring a drawing to life: a photo or scan of a hand-drawn picture in your MegaScenes library, turned into a short animation that keeps the same lines, colors and paper.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a photo or a scan of the drawing from your MegaScenes library, a crayon dragon, a pencil sketch or your little one's artwork from the fridge, and describe how it should move: the dragon flaps its wings and flies, the sun smiles and the flowers sway, the rocket takes off. You get a short animation that keeps the same lines, colors and paper, as if the drawing itself came to life.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the animation needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The video plays in the chat and stays in your library next to the drawing.

For parents, grandparents and teachers who want to surprise the artist, and for anyone with a sketchbook.

Limitations: a short clip of a few seconds from one drawing, silent unless you ask for sound and the model offers it. The drawing must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Original drawings only, not characters or brands owned by others. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Animate a drawing the way you describe
Return the video in the chat
defaultPrompt: Animate the dragon drawing in my MegaScenes library so it flaps its wings and flies
Make the sun in my latest drawing smile and the flowers sway
Bring my little one's rocket drawing to life as it takes off

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Animate the dragon drawing in my MegaScenes library so it flaps its wings and flies. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one animated drawing needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which video models can animate a drawing here?
positive.expected_behavior: The animation models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Animate the rocket drawing in my latest MegaScenes upload so it takes off into a starry sky. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my animation on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my animation to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
